text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":1,"unit":"week","kind":"count","span":"In one week"},{"id":"q2","value":1134,"unit":"miles","kind":"count","span":"1,134 miles on Tuesday"},{"id":"q3","value":1475,"unit":"miles","kind":"count","span":"1,475 miles on Thursday"},{"id":"q4","value":3,"unit":"weeks","kind":"count","span":"3 weeks in a row"}],"plan":[{"op":"add","args":["q2","q3"],"out":"s1","note":"add Tuesday and Thursday miles together to get one week total"},{"op":"mul","args":["s1","q4"],"out":"s2","note":"multiply one week total by 3 weeks to get the overall miles flown"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"total miles flown over the three weeks"},"dismissed":[{"value":1,"reason":"states the Tuesday and Thursday flights both happened within a single week; it doesn't add to or multiply the mileage total, which is already built from those two flight distances"}]}
